definitions.question: Column widths (D1, confirmed and widened): should C# cut every VarChar parameter of the header INSERT to the real column width, as the SP parameters did, or should MetodoEnvio and sexo be widened with ALTER TABLE? As part of the same decision: what should sexo hold when the BP Gender is empty or not '1'/'2'?
definitions.lan: The SP parameters cut values silently before the INSERT: @MetodoEnvio VARCHAR(12) at SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:147 and @sexo VARCHAR(9) at :100. So 'tablerate_bestway' was stored as 'tablerate_be' and 'NO ESPECIFICADO' as 'NO ESPECI'. LAN copied CTE.Sexo as text (LAN CreditMethods.cs:837 -> :158), and a NULL became ''. LAN web customers got UPPER(@SexoCte) (SP_eCommerceCtenuevo.sql:109-134).
definitions.sap: SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:163-221 adds every VarChar parameter with no Size. MetodoEnvio is the whole order.metodoEnvio (SS OrderMethods.cs:830). sexo comes from SexoLegado (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:558-573): '1' gives Masculino, '2' gives Femenino, and anything else, including '' and null, gives 'NO ESPECIFICADO' (15 chars). Either value raises SQL error 8152/2628 at :223. No header row is written, the promo code is not burned, and the answer is 'Error, ...' (R4).
definitions.business_impact: Every captured credit payload fails: CRED515773 and CRED515848 both send metodoEnvio 'tablerate_bestway' (Resources/magento_payloads.md:26, :55). Store pickup fails too: 'instore_pickup' is 14 chars (SS OrderMethods.cs:58; Magento OrderManagement.php:649, :699). So does every BP whose Gender is not 1/2, including the only captured BP05MA, 1500004598 (Gender '9'), and BPs registered without a sex (Gender '' or '3'). Once Magento sends BPs, ServicioSAP cannot create a single credit application for a real shipping method. Other columns may fail the same way where the real width equals the old parameter width (nombre 25, apellidos 30, email 50, rfc 13, estado 30, estadoCivil 11, condicion 20, TelefonoValidar 10). §22.3 records only 4 widths, so for the others: NO EVIDENCE.
options: Give every VarChar parameter a Size equal to the real column width from the DDL the user already ran. This cuts client-side as LAN did, gives exact LAN values for MetodoEnvio and sexo, keeps fuller values where the column is wider than the old parameter (direccion 100, cliente 10), and makes 8152 impossible.
Cut only MetodoEnvio to 12 and sexo to 9. The other exact-width columns stay a risk.
ALTER TABLE: widen MetodoEnvio (e.g. 50) and sexo (>= 15). Needs the DBA; any other exact-width column is still a risk.
Sexo sub-choice: map an empty or null Gender to '' (what LAN stored for a NULL CTE.Sexo) and other non-1/2 codes to 'NO ESPECIFICADO' cut to 9, or cut everything to 9.
definitions.evidence: SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:100, :147; SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:163-221, :223, :239, :558-573; SS OrderMethods.cs:58, :830; runbook PLAN_EJECUCION_SP_CREDITO_A_CODIGO.md §22.3 (DDL: MetodoEnvio varchar(12), sexo varchar(9), cliente 10, direccion 100); magento_payloads.md:26, :55; CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md (BP 1500004598 Gender '9'); BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:482, :779-795; SP_eCommerceCtenuevo.sql:109-134. Spot-checked by the synthesizer: SP lines 100/147, SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:169/:209/:558-573, §22.3.
definitions.recommendation: Option 1, plus the sexo sub-choice ''-for-empty / 'NO ESPECI' for other codes (LAN values in both cases). It is one change in InsertarSolicitudAsync and needs no DBA. Before choosing, ask Credit whether anyone reads the full MetodoEnvio; if someone does, add the ALTER for that column only. A related data issue: BPs created from orders default Gender to '1' (SS OrderMethods.cs:2670), so their applications say 'Masculino' regardless of the customer. That is the pending item in §17.4.

definitions.question: Test environment: where may credit test rows be written, and who deletes them? Is mavicbosandroid.grupomavi.com/ServicioAndroid production, and is there a non-production copy to point MAVICBOSANDROID at?
definitions.lan: LAN writes the header to the same server and database (LAN Conn/Connection.cs:28). It writes the lines through the linked server MAVIANDROID01.ServicioAndroid (SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea.sql:208, :243).
definitions.sap: ServicioSAP's Web.config:13 points MAVICBOSANDROID at server mavicbosandroid.grupomavi.com, database ServicioAndroid. Every order/new credit request runs SELECTs there (SS OrderMethods.cs:1801, before the guest and BP checks at :675/:681). A positive run INSERTs 1 header row plus N line rows there. Web.local.config can override appSettings only, not connectionStrings, and no Web.local.config exists on the share.
definitions.business_impact: Test rows would land in the table the Credit area and the liberador read. The response carries no request id, so the rows can only be found by idMagento. Any deletion needs the database owner.
options: A non-production copy, switched with a local, uncommitted edit of Web.config:13 (and :15 ADMINDOC if needed), made by the user
Written acceptance of test rows in the current database, with a named person who deletes them by idMagento
definitions.evidence: Web.config:13, :17-20 (synthesizer read it, secrets masked); SS OrderMethods.cs:1791, :1801-1804; SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:157-223; testability analyst 'writes' list; runbook §18.4, §18.9
definitions.recommendation: Get the DBA's answer before any positive run. Under the standing rule, the user, not Claude, runs every request that touches this database, negative tests included.

definitions.question: When will the AWS catalog 'ORIGEN VALIDACION NUMERO CTE' be registered (VALOR1 = valid origins), and which ZappOrig value will e-commerce write for a phone validated on the web?
definitions.lan: TablaStD held the origins for TablaSt='ORIGEN VALIDACION NUMERO CTE'. The SP joined CteTel.AppOrigen against them (SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:186-191).
definitions.sap: ConstruirContextoAsync reads the catalog only when TelefonoValidado is not null (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:387-396). ProductMethods.GetConfiguracionCatalogoAsync throws on a non-2xx status or an empty body (ProductMethods.cs:724-725, :733), which aborts the INSERT. An answer of 200 with [] makes @ValidacionOrigen NULL, so ValidacionTelefono can never be 0 for a non-prospect. BPs created by ServicioSAP send ZappOrig '' (SS OrderMethods.cs:2857).
definitions.business_impact: If the catalog is missing and the API answers non-2xx or an empty body, every credit order from a BP with a validated phone fails with 'Error, ...' and no application is written. If it answers [], every such customer is sent for phone validation (1) where LAN gave 0. Which of the two happens: NO EVIDENCE.
options: Register the catalog with the legacy origins (MappingMetods/CatalogoConfiguracion.csv) plus the e-commerce value
Leave it unregistered and accept one of the two behaviours above
definitions.evidence: SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:381-400, :443-474, :521-530; ProductMethods.cs:708-735 (spot-checked); SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:186-191; runbook :1138-1161, :1425
definitions.recommendation: Treat it as a data prerequisite for the phone-validation tests (P4/P5). First runs can use a BP with no validated phone, which skips the catalog entirely.

definitions.question: Validated phone rule (D2, refined): should one C# helper apply LAN's rule (ZtipoCte MOVIL, Zvaltel true, newest Zfecha with nulls last) to BOTH lookups, @TelefonoValidado for ValidacionTelefono and IsValidatedAsync for LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar, and should ZtelCte be reduced to 10 digits?
definitions.lan: LAN uses one rule in two places: IsValidated (LAN OrderMethods.cs:794-795) and @TelefonoValidado (SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:194-202). Both run CteTel WHERE Tipo='Movil' AND ValidacionTel=1 ORDER BY Fecha DESC and return CONCAT(Lada,Telefono). SQL puts NULL dates last. The SP compares the first 10 chars (VARCHAR(10), :165-166).
definitions.sap: There are two different rules. (1) GetTelefonoValidadoAsync (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:476-519) calls the FastAPI A_GET_TelefonoValidado. That route takes max() over ALL CteTelSet phones by (Zfecha, ZfechaCap, ZidcteTel) with no type or validation filter (A_GET_TelefonoValidado.py:5-36). A null date becomes '00000000' (AS_GET_ZQBP_EditarCliente_CteTel.py:60-62), which sorts above '/Date(ms)/' because '0' > '/', so undated phones win. ServicioSAP keeps the result only if it is validated. (2) IsValidatedAsync (SS OrderMethods.cs:646-653) reads BP05MA to_CteTel and takes FirstOrDefault of MOVIL + Zvaltel + a non-blank ZappOrig. It has no date order, and the ZappOrig filter has no LAN counterpart. Neither rule normalizes ZtelCte ('+52...' or 7-digit values exist, CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:49-56).
definitions.business_impact: Real BP 1500004598: the SP rule picks the validated, dated MOVIL 5522122584. The API picks one of four undated rows, and none of them is a validated MOVIL, so ServicioSAP gives ValidacionTelefono 1 where LAN gave 0: a customer whose mobile is already validated is asked to validate again. In the reverse case (the only validated phone is the newest row but it is a landline), LAN gives 1 and ServicioSAP gives 0. Separately, for LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar: a validated MOVIL with a blank ZappOrig (every BP ServicioSAP creates, SS OrderMethods.cs:2857) is skipped, and the order phone is used instead.
options: A: One helper over IList<BusinessPhone>, used in ConstruirContextoAsync (reading CteTelSet first) and in IsValidatedAsync. It filters MOVIL (ignoring case and trailing spaces) and Zvaltel, orders by parsed Zfecha descending with nulls last (tiebreak ZfechaCap desc, then numeric ZidcteTel desc), reduces to digits, and drops a leading 52 when 12 digits. It overrides §15.1 and removes the URL_BP_API dependency from this path.
B: The businesspartner-api owner fixes A_GET_TelefonoValidado. Needs a deploy, and IsValidatedAsync still differs.
C: Accept the divergence.
definitions.evidence: SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:165-166, :194-221 (spot-checked); LAN OrderMethods.cs:620, :642, :786-817 (spot-checked); SS OrderMethods.cs:631-660, :688 (spot-checked); SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:476-519, :602-610 (spot-checked); businesspartner-dev/apps/api/routes/A_GET_TelefonoValidado.py:5-36 and AS_GET_ZQBP_EditarCliente_CteTel.py:60-62 (spot-checked); CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:49-61, :88-96; runbook §22.4
definitions.recommendation: Option A for both lookups. Keep the ZappOrig check only in @ValidacionOrigen, which is where the SP had it. This does not stop a run from executing, but P4/P5 cannot assert an expected ValidacionTelefono until it is decided.

definitions.question: Payment condition cannot be resolved (decision 9, which dropped off the §22.8 list): should ServicioSAP resolve the condition BEFORE writing the header and answer 'Error, ...', or keep today's behaviour (header written, no lines, 'Concluido')?
definitions.lan: No check. The header is written, the product lines insert 0 rows (SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea.sql:258-262), SEGU00001 is still inserted (its branch ignores @Condicion, :179-216), the promo code is burned, and Magento gets the account.
definitions.sap: The header is written first (SS OrderMethods.cs:694). GetCondicionAsync then resolves to '' and InsertCreditArticlesAsync throws before any line (:877-880). The catch at :711-717 only logs, so there are no lines, no SEGU00001 and no promo burn, and the answer is 'Concluido' (:1806-1811). A first article with no condicion takes the same path.
definitions.business_impact: An order with an unknown condition leaves an orphan application with no article or shipping line, and nobody is told. The user's decision 9 ('se debe detener ... notificar') is only half applied: it stops, but after the header is written, and it notifies no one except sap.log.
options: Resolve the condition before CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync and throw: no header, 'Error, ...' plus a sap.log entry (R4)
Keep writing the header, but rethrow so Magento gets 'Error, ...'
Keep the current behaviour and record it as intentional
definitions.evidence: SS OrderMethods.cs:694-717, :875-880, :3329-3361 (spot-checked); SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea.sql:179-216, :258-262; runbook §18.5 #7, §20.3 (decision 9 at :1503), P14
definitions.recommendation: Option 1. Only P14's expected result depends on this; the happy-path tests do not.

definitions.question: Condition translation source for credit lines: does SIGMAVI CondicionesCredVtaLinea really have a CondicionMagento column, and does its Condicion column hold the SD29 code (12IA/12IV)? If not, which source is the truth: the in-memory PaymentConditionCatalog, or a query with LAN's semantics?
definitions.lan: VTASCCondicionesCredVtaLinea WHERE Condicion = <Magento text>, joined through CondicionPropre to PropreListaDFinal.Condicion (SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea.sql:258-261), with no store filter.
definitions.sap: SELECT TOP 1 Condicion FROM CondicionesCredVtaLinea WHERE CondicionMagento=@c AND REPLACE(TiendaVirtual,' ','_')=@storeId (SS OrderMethods.cs:3337-3339). Any error is logged and swallowed, and then PaymentConditionCatalog is used (:3355-3360); '12 M MA P INM' maps to 12IA and '12 M VIU P INM' to 12IV (PaymentConditionCatalog.cs:61, :64). The result must equal the SD29 Condition for OrgVtas 04/05 (:969-972).
definitions.business_impact: If SIGMAVI returns a value that is not the SD29 code, no SD29 row matches. Every product line is then skipped silently (SS OrderMethods.cs:974-978), the application has only SEGU00001, and Magento gets 'Concluido'. If the column does not exist, every order logs a SIGMAVI error and runs on the catalog, which works for the two captured conditions.
options: Keep SIGMAVI first plus the catalog fallback, after a read-only SELECT confirms the columns and values
Use only PaymentConditionCatalog for credit
Rewrite the query to LAN's semantics, if SIGMAVI stores the SD29 codes
definitions.evidence: SS OrderMethods.cs:875, :3329-3361 (spot-checked); PaymentConditionCatalog.cs:55-70, :122-138 (spot-checked); SpVTASInsertArtSolCreditoLinea.sql:258-261; runbook :1429 (still open). The SIGMAVI column: NO EVIDENCE.
definitions.recommendation: The user runs SELECT TOP 20 * FROM CondicionesCredVtaLinea on SIGMAVI before P2/P3; the result tells which option is right. Until then, whether the P2/P3 product line gets written depends on SIGMAVI data.

definitions.question: Promoter coupons, data (W1 extended): which table and database is the single source of truth? The candidates are SIGMAVI 'VentaCupon' (the name recorded as confirmed), 'VentasCupones' (what the code uses) and IntelisisTmp.VTASCVentaCupon. What is its DDL, are the open Intelisis rows migrated, which branch numbering does Centro/Sucursal use, and which promoter code format will Magento send (Intelisis E-code or SAP personnel number)?
definitions.lan: SpVTASVentaCupon runs in IntelisisTmp on VTASCVentaCupon (IdVentaCupon, Codigo, Agente, FechaEnvio, Cliente, Sucursal, FechaUtilizacion, IdEcommerce). The branch comes from Intelisis Agente JOIN Sucursal (SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:139-159). The code is matched natively against Intelisis Personal/Agente ids.
definitions.sap: HandlePromoCodeAsync reads and writes 'VentasCupones' in SIGMavi via the DEVMAVI alias (SS OrderMethods.cs:1041, :1095, :1144); the host behind DEVMAVI is NO EVIDENCE. It inserts columns BP and Centro. The branch comes from the businesspartner-api AS_GET_ZQBP_AGENTE Werks plus SucursalesSet (:1105-1140). The raw code is sent as the SuccessFactors user_id and as Zagente.
definitions.business_impact: If SIGMAVI has only 'VentaCupon', the COUNT at :1041 throws, nothing is burned or regenerated for any promoter, and nothing is logged. If the table is empty at cutover, every coupon already issued in IntelisisTmp is never stamped. If the columns are Cliente/Sucursal, the INSERT fails after the UPDATE has committed. If promoters keep using E-codes (the captured promoter order CRED511270 carries 'E016881'), Centro is NULL, and whether SuccessFactors finds the code is NO EVIDENCE.
options: Align the code to the SIGMAVI answer: table name, column names, identity column (needed for TOP 1), widths
Keep the burn in IntelisisTmp until validation and burn move together
Re-key coupons to SAP personnel numbers during migration, or map Intelisis codes to SAP ids before the lookups
definitions.evidence: SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:1, :115-160 (spot-checked); SS OrderMethods.cs:1039-1170 (spot-checked); _NUESTROS_ENDPOINTS/_DECISIONES_ODS.md:175; CHECKLIST_DEV3_NOSAP_NOINTELISIS.md:315-334; businesspartner-dev AS_ZQBP_AGENTE.py:95-96; Hoppscotch manual :879
definitions.recommendation: Send SIGMAVI the four data questions (table and server, DDL, migration, Centro numbering) and ask Magento/HR about the code format. Until then, keep codigo_promotor empty in every test. This blocks only promo-path tests.

definitions.question: Promoter coupons, rules: should the burn keep LAN semantics (no gate at order time, stamp only the newest free row, always regenerate) and should checkout validation move to ServicioSAP with LAN's first-row insert? Or should ServicioSAP keep its gate (a free row, or SuccessFactors plus the AWS catalog) and its 'stamp all free rows' UPDATE?
definitions.lan: ValidarCupon counts ANY row of the code. For a valid employee with no row it inserts the first free row (SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:60-106). 'Elimina' has no gate: it runs UPDATE TOP(1) on the newest free row, then always runs NUEVO (:115-136). So a promoter's first sale is recorded on the row that validation created. Magento validates through the DMZ route credit/codigoPromocion, which still points at LAN.
definitions.sap: The burn is gated (SS OrderMethods.cs:1039-1083); an invalid code writes nothing. The UPDATE has no TOP (:1095). Regeneration runs only when the code is valid (:1091, :1142-1158). ServicioSAP's own ValidarCupon never inserts (:1085-1088), counts only free rows, and returns JSON {status}, while Magento expects 'OK'/'Erroneo'/'Utilizado'; nothing calls it. The §22.5 note that 'first use leaves no IdEcommerce row in LAN either' is refuted by SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:91-105.
definitions.business_impact: (a) A promoter's first sale is attributed in LAN and not in ServicioSAP: validation writes IntelisisTmp while the burn looks in SIGMavi. (b) An employee whose SuccessFactors Department/Title does not match the catalog, or any SuccessFactors or AWS outage, means no coupon is ever regenerated. (c) Several free rows are all stamped with one IdEcommerce. This is latent, because LAN's own flows keep at most one free row per code.
options: LAN parity: no gate at 'Elimina', TOP(1) newest free row, always regenerate; move ValidarCupon to ServicioSAP with the LAN insert and response strings
Keep the gate as a new rule, but use TOP(1), log gate rejections, and define the catalog rule precisely
Keep the current behaviour (needs business sign-off that first sales go unattributed)
definitions.evidence: SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:60-160 (spot-checked); SS OrderMethods.cs:1028-1170 (spot-checked); SS Controllers/OrderController.cs:102-120; Magento Mavi/CreditoCheckout credito-checkout-functions.js:236-283 (not spot-checked); DMZ CreditController.cs:127-138 (not spot-checked); runbook §22.5 #6
definitions.recommendation: LAN parity, decided after the W1 answer. Validation and burn should move together.

definitions.question: NIP SMS (credit/getSms and validateSms): will these move to ServicioSAP, or stay in LAN with a BP-to-Intelisis mapping?
definitions.lan: getSms writes the NIP rows (VTASDCodigoVerificacioneCommerce plus TcAAEA00030 with the validated mobile), and only for accounts that exist in Intelisis Cte (LAN CreditMethods.cs:2102-2262). setOrder's SMS lookups then find that phone.
definitions.sap: ServicioSAP has no such route (Controllers/CreditController.cs:17-133). The DMZ still sends getSms/validateSms to LAN and only SendSmsNewNumber to ServicioSAP.
definitions.business_impact: Once Magento sends BP accounts (R1 final state), LAN getSms finds no Intelisis Cte, returns 0, and the DMZ answers 400. Customers can then fail the NIP step, and no SMS row is written, so LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar fall back to IsValidatedAsync or the order phone.
options: Port getSms/validateSms to ServicioSAP, reusing the Q4 helper
Keep them in LAN with an account mapping
Defer until Magento sends BPs
definitions.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:21-25, :2102-2262; DMZ Controllers/CreditController.cs:66-97, :302-310; SS Controllers/CreditController.cs:10-133; SS Methods/Credit/CreditMethods.cs:117-148 (none spot-checked by the synthesizer)
definitions.recommendation: Port it with the Q4 helper before Magento switches to BPs. Direct order/new tests do not depend on it.

definitions.question: Short or invalid phone: when the SMS, validated or order phone is shorter than its lada (or the lada is not numeric), should ServicioSAP stop like LAN (no row) or insert placeholders (lada 0, TelefonoParticular '', TelefonoValidar '0')?
definitions.lan: Substring throws inside the try (LAN CreditMethods.cs:139-148), the catch returns 'err' (:246-252), and nothing is written. Magento still gets the account (LAN OrderMethods.cs:649).
definitions.sap: The guards at SS OrderMethods.cs:687-691 and :795-801 give LadaValidar 0, TelefonoValidar '0', LadaParticular/LadaCelular 0 and TelefonoParticular/TelefonoCelular ''. The row, the lines and the promo burn all go ahead, and the answer is 'Concluido'.
definitions.business_impact: Order telefono '12' with no SMS row: LAN writes no application; ServicioSAP writes one that nobody can call. It is rare, because Magento strips non-digits (OrderManagement.php:731).
options: Throw before InsertAsync (no row, 'Error, ...' per R4)
Keep inserting with placeholders
definitions.evidence: LAN CreditMethods.cs:139-148, :246-252 (spot-checked); SS OrderMethods.cs:687-691, :792-801, :831-839 (spot-checked); runbook §20.3
definitions.recommendation: Throw with a clear message: an application with no usable phone cannot be validated.

definitions.question: Birth date: when the BP has no Birthdt, should the application be written with fechaNacimiento NULL (today), with '1900-01-02' (what LAN web customers carried), or not written at all?
definitions.lan: LAN web customers were created by SP_eCommerceCtenuevo with FechaNacimiento '1900-01-02' (SP_eCommerceCtenuevo.sql:109-111, :140), so their applications carried '1900-01-02'. A CTE row with a real NULL made Convert.ToDateTime throw (LAN CreditMethods.cs:835). getClientInfo then returned a short list, datosCliente[4] threw at :156, and no row was written.
definitions.sap: FechaSap(maestro.Birthdt) returns null, which is inserted as NULL (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:167, :237, :575-600). BPs created by ServicioSAP from orders never set Birthdt (runbook/logs: 'Birthdt':null).
definitions.business_impact: A returning customer whose BP was created by an earlier ServicioSAP order gets an application with no birth date, where the equivalent LAN web customer had '1900-01-02'. Whether Credit or the liberador handle NULL: NO EVIDENCE.
options: Keep NULL
Write '1900-01-02' when Birthdt is missing
Reject the application with an explicit error
definitions.evidence: SP_eCommerceCtenuevo.sql:109-140 (spot-checked); LAN CreditMethods.cs:804-868, :156 (spot-checked); SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:167, :237, :575-600 (spot-checked); SS OrderMethods.cs:808, :2651-2690
definitions.recommendation: '1900-01-02', unless Credit confirms that NULL is handled. Do not copy LAN's silent abort.

definitions.question: Brand-new client (D4, confirmed): keep ValidacionTelefono = 1 for an empty cuenta, and for BPs that ServicioSAP creates with ZtipoCliente ''?
definitions.lan: A new client never reached the SP (checkCliente('') is false, LAN CreditMethods.cs:124, :255-258). The SP rule IIF(SUBSTRING(@cliente,1,1) != 'P', 1, 0) gives 1 for '' and 0 only for NULL (SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:216).
definitions.sap: EsProspecto(null) is false, and GetTelefonoValidadoAsync returns null without any HTTP call. So the IF is true and the result is 1 (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:312-328, :478-481, :532-542). BPs created by ServicioSAP write ZtipoCliente '' (SS OrderMethods.cs:2845; BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:654), so they are never prospects either.
definitions.business_impact: Every first-purchase application is flagged for phone validation. It would get 0 only if first-time web buyers count as prospects.
options: Keep 1 (the literal SP result for an empty cliente)
Force 0 for an empty cuenta
Write ZtipoCliente 'Prospecto' when ServicioSAP creates the BP
definitions.evidence: SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:210-221 (spot-checked); SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:312-328, :471-481, :532-546 (spot-checked); SS OrderMethods.cs:825
definitions.recommendation: Keep 1 unless Credit says first-time web buyers are prospects; in that case take option 3. Only P11's expected value depends on this.

definitions.question: New-client row traceability (content of the R2 row, not the flow): should ClienteMagento be set to the Magento customer id when cuenta is empty?
definitions.lan: LAN never wrote a new-client row and never passed @ClienteMagento.
definitions.sap: The row gets cliente '' and ClienteMagento NULL. The column is bound (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:208, :286) but never set (SS OrderMethods.cs:803-840). The Magento id survives only in the response (:759).
definitions.business_impact: Until a BP exists, only the email, the names and idMagento link the application to the customer. The liberador contract (R3) may need this link.
options: Set ClienteMagento = infoCliente.cliente for new clients
Leave NULL until the liberador contract defines the link
definitions.evidence: SS OrderMethods.cs:670, :759, :803-840 (spot-checked); SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:208, :286 (spot-checked); SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:145
definitions.recommendation: Set it. It has no effect on existing-BP rows. The old parameter was varchar(12); the column width is NO EVIDENCE.

definitions.question: estadoCivil: accept '' for now, or map it from BP05MA Marst once a code table exists?
definitions.lan: CTE.EstadoCivil (LAN CreditMethods.cs:169, :847), cut to 11. Web-created customers had none, because SP_eCommerceCtenuevo.sql:109-111 does not insert EstadoCivil, so for them LAN also wrote ''.
definitions.sap: Always '' (SS OrderMethods.cs:821 -> SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:254). Marst is deserialized but unused. BPs created by ServicioSAP carry a hard-coded Marst ('2' from orders, '1' from registration).
definitions.business_impact: Only store-registered customers lose a marital status that LAN carried. Mapping Marst now would write invented values for BPs that ServicioSAP created.
options: Accept '' and record it as a known gap

synthesis.test_verdict_reason:
The method can be tested through its only entry point, POST order/new, but not right now.

**What runs now.** The build and the read-only checks: SAP GETs through existing JWT routes, the FastAPI and AWS GETs, and SQL SELECTs that the user runs.

**Why no credit request can run yet.** Every order/new credit request runs SELECTs on mavicbosandroid.grupomavi.com/ServicioAndroid before any guard (SS OrderMethods.cs:1801, spot-checked), and writes the local SQLite guide row (:1791). That database is LAN's, and it may be production. A positive run also INSERTs the header and lines there. So any run first needs:
1. A confirmed non-production database, with MAVICBOSANDROID switched in Web.config:13. Web.local.config cannot override connectionStrings.
2. The user's explicit go-ahead. Under the standing rule, the user runs these requests himself.
3. IIS Express started by the user, plus a JWT.
4. A QA BP in client 110 with Gender 1/2, and a SKU priced in SD29 for 04/05.
5. D1 fixed. Without it, any real payload fails with 8152 and writes no row (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:223). That is a useful negative test, but not a positive one.

**Outside a positive run.** The ValidacionTelefono assertions wait on D2 and the AWS catalog. P14 waits on the condition decision (Q5). The promo path waits on W1. End to end with Magento is not possible until R1 and R3 are done. The credit path makes no SAP writes and calls no webhooks.

definitions_needed.question: D1 (confirmed, with a new case): truncate MetodoEnvio to 12 and sexo to 9 in C# as the SP did, or ALTER TABLE?
definitions_needed.lan_behavior: The SP parameters @MetodoEnvio VARCHAR(12) (SPW:147) and @sexo VARCHAR(9) (SPW:100) cut the values silently. The INSERT succeeds and lines, promo and liberador follow.
definitions_needed.sap_behavior: A direct INSERT with no parameter Size (SCW:169, :209). The value comes from order.metodoEnvio (SS-OM:830) and SexoLegado (SCW:239, :558-573). A longer value raises 8152/2628, the header is not written, the promo is not burned, and the answer is "Error, ...".
definitions_needed.business_impact: Every captured credit payload ('tablerate_bestway', 17 chars) fails to create its application. So would store-pickup credit orders: 'instore_pickup' is 14 chars and registerCreditQuote sends it for pickup (MG\Omnipro\PlaceOrder\Model\OrderManagement.php:649, :699). So would every BP whose Gender is not '1' or '2' ('NO ESPECIFICADO', 15 chars). LAN stored 'tablerate_be', 'instore_pick' and 'NO ESPECI'.
options: Truncate those two fields in C# before the INSERT (exact LAN parity, no DBA needed)
ALTER TABLE to widen MetodoEnvio and sexo (DBA; stores full values)
definitions_needed.evidence: SPW:100, :147; SCW:169, :209, :239, :558-573; SS-OM:830; RB §22.3 (DDL: MetodoEnvio varchar(12), sexo varchar(9))
definitions_needed.recommendation: Truncate in C# now: it is parity and unblocks testing. Widen the columns later if the business wants full values.

definitions_needed.question: D2 (refined): when the SP's validated-phone rule moves into C#, should it also replace OrderMethods.IsValidatedAsync, so that both 'validated phone' lookups use one rule?
definitions_needed.lan_behavior: LAN uses the same rule in both places: CteTel Tipo='Movil' AND ValidacionTel=1 ORDER BY Fecha DESC, in IsValidated (LAN-OM:794-795, which feeds LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar) and in @TelefonoValidado (SPW:194-202, which feeds ValidacionTelefono).
definitions_needed.sap_behavior: SAP has two different rules. IsValidatedAsync (SS-OM:646-651) uses BP05MA MOVIL + Zvaltel and ALSO requires a non-blank ZappOrig, takes the first in OData order, and has no Zfecha ordering. GetTelefonoValidadoAsync (SCW:476-519) takes the newest phone of any type from A_GET_TelefonoValidado (RB §22.4).
definitions_needed.business_impact: Example: a BP with two validated mobiles, the newer one with an empty ZappOrig, and no SMS row. LAN validates against the newer mobile. SAP uses the older one, or "", and falls back to the order phone. So LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar in the application differ.
options: Option A for both: one helper over to_CteTel/CteTelSet with MOVIL + Zvaltel, ordered by Zfecha DESC, and no ZappOrig filter in the numeroValidado lookup
Fix only GetTelefonoValidadoAsync / the FastAPI and leave IsValidatedAsync as it is (RB §17.4)
definitions_needed.evidence: LAN-OM:786-817; SPW:194-202; SS-OM:631-660; SCW:476-519; BP05MA model has Zfecha (Models\SAP\BusinessPartner\BP05MA\BusinessEntitiesMa.cs:12)
definitions_needed.recommendation: Option A for both lookups. The ZappOrig rule belongs only to @ValidacionOrigen (SPW:186-191), not to the validated-phone lookup.

definitions_needed.question: Decision 9 (dropped from the §22.8 list): when the payment condition does not exist, should ServicioSAP stop BEFORE writing the header, keep the current header-only row, or match LAN?
definitions_needed.lan_behavior: LAN does not validate. The header is written with the Magento condition, product lines get 0 rows (SPL:258-262), SEGU00001 is still inserted, the promoter is burned, the liberador is started for 'C' accounts, and the cuenta is returned.
definitions_needed.sap_behavior: The header is written first (SS-OM:694). Then GetCondicionAsync resolves to empty and InsertCreditArticlesAsync throws (SS-OM:875-880). The catch (SS-OM:711-717) logs it: no lines, no SEGU, no promo burn, and the answer is 'Concluido'.
definitions_needed.business_impact: An order with a condition that is in neither CondicionesCredVtaLinea nor the catalog leaves an application with no lines and no shipping line. Nothing tells Magento. The user's decision 9 ('se debe detener ... notificar') is only half applied.
options: Resolve the condition before CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync and throw, so there is no header and the answer is "Error, ..." plus a log
Keep the current behaviour (header only, logged, 'Concluido')
LAN parity: no validation, write SEGU and burn the promo
definitions_needed.recommendation: Validate first (option 1). Because Magento ignores the body, the 'notify' part in practice is the sap.log entry. The expected result of P14 cannot be fixed until this is decided.

definitions_needed.question: W1 (refined): even if VentasCupones and VTASCVentaCupon turn out to be the same coupons, should the 'Elimina' step copy SpVTASVentaCupon literally?
definitions_needed.lan_behavior: 'Elimina' has no validity gate. It stamps only the newest free row (UPDATE TOP(1) ... ORDER BY IdVentaCupon DESC) and ALWAYS inserts a new free row, with Sucursal from Intelisis Agente/Sucursal (SPC:115-160). The order of operations matches LAN: article list, SMS phone, validated phone, existence check, header insert, lines, promoter burn, then the liberador (still commented out, R3). A failure partway through the lines leaves the same state on both sides: the header plus the first lines, no promoter burn, and a success reply.

The biggest new finding comes from the Magento248 code on the share: Magento ignores the setOrder body and status for credit orders. It marks every accepted call PROCESANDO, deactivates the cart, and waits for the authorizationResult callback. So the new response shape and the "Error, ..." texts change nothing for the customer. Until R3 is done, every credit order stays pending whether ServicioSAP succeeded or failed. Errors show up only in sap.log.

Divergences that need a decision:
- D1 blocks testing. Besides 'tablerate_bestway', 'instore_pickup' (14 chars) also exceeds MetodoEnvio varchar(12).

Four real bugs on the credit path:
1. Logger.SAP can throw inside the catches that are meant to swallow errors, turning a Concluido into an error or an HTTP 500.
2. The new-client flow looks up the SMS phone with an empty account.
3. The guest guard never fires for Magento payloads, which send cliente as 0.
4. The promoter coupon can be burned without a replacement being created, with nothing written to sap.log.

areas.summary: The SP block that computes ValidacionTelefono is ported faithfully, including SQL three-valued logic: ResolverValidacionTelefono at SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:312-328 matches SP:210-221. The IF overwrites the incoming @ValidacionTelefono, so LAN's isValidated and IsInTableStd were dead and removing them is correct. @ValidacionOrigen (CteTelSet plus the AWS catalog) and @TelefonoAValidar (the same TcAAEA00030 query) are equivalent; the prospect rule (ZtipoCliente) is an intentional redesign. The real divergence is the input @TelefonoValidado. The FastAPI A_GET_TelefonoValidado returns the most recent phone of ANY type, and undated rows win because null dates become '00000000'. ServicioSAP keeps it only if validated. The SP instead picks the most recent validated MOVIL, with NULL dates last. So customers with a newer landline or unvalidated phone, or any undated row (such as real BP 1500004598, or phones ServicioSAP creates with Zfecha=null), get 1 where LAN gave 0, and a customer whose only validated phone is a landline gets 0 where LAN gave 1. A second instance of the same rule, IsValidatedAsync (numeroValidado -> LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar), diverges differently: it has an extra ZappOrig filter, no Fecha ordering, and reads BP05MA. Rule the user must define: a validated phone = ZtipoCte MOVIL (ignoring case) and Zvaltel true, latest Zfecha with nulls last, plus a tiebreak (suggested ZfechaCap desc, then ZidcteTel desc), with a normalization decision for ZtelCte. Minimum change for parity: one C# helper over IList<BusinessPhone>, used both in ConstruirContextoAsync (read CteTelSet first, derive TelefonoValidado, stop early if it is null) and in IsValidatedAsync, replacing the predicate at OrderMethods.cs:646-651. This overrides §15.1 and needs the user's go-ahead. D4: ServicioSAP gives 1 for an empty cuenta, which is also what the SP gives for an empty @cliente, and ServicioSAP-created BPs (ZtipoCliente \"\") are never prospects. Two prerequisites affect testing: the AWS catalog 'ORIGEN VALIDACION NUMERO CTE' and the ecommerce ZappOrig value, and getSms/validateSms, which still run in LAN and write nothing for BP accounts. steps.lan: None. 'Elimina' goes straight to UPDATE and then EXEC 'NUEVO' (SP:115-136).
steps.sap: There is a gate. First SELECT COUNT(*) of free rows (OM:1039-1051). If that finds none, it calls SuccessFactors get_personalById?user_id={code}&status=0 (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:342-374), then reads the AWS catalog 'Código de promotor' (ProductMethods.cs:708-735). The code passes only if some row has Valor1 == Department AND Valor2 == Title, whole-string and case-insensitive (OM:1059-1076). Any SF or catalog exception is swallowed and counts as invalid (OM:1079-1082). The burn runs only if the code is valid (OM:1091); otherwise the method returns 'NO_VALIDO' and writes nothing (OM:1163).
steps.note: The results differ for a code with no free row: a promoter's first use in SIGMavi, a code whose coupon is already used, a stale or unvalidated code, or SF/AWS being down. LAN always writes a new free row; SAP writes nothing unless SF and the catalog accept the code. PLAN §15.2 (TablaStD moved to AWS) makes the data source intentional, but no decision endorses gating the burn. Manual Tecnico Servicio SAP 26082026.md:293 says the catalog holds legacy keys (e.g. D40) while the API returns SF names, so promoters get rejected (that is documentation; runtime evidence is NO EVIDENCE). steps.lan: WITH Cupon AS (SELECT TOP (1) ... WHERE Codigo=@codigo AND FechaUtilizacion IS NULL ORDER BY IdVentaCupon DESC) UPDATE Cupon SET FechaUtilizacion=GETDATE(), IdEcommerce=@IdEcommerce (SP:118-128). One row.

steps.note: This is latent in steady state. The SP's own flows keep at most one free row per code: ValidarCupon inserts only when COUNT(*)=0 (SP:64-70, 91-105), and Elimina stamps one row and then inserts one. More than one free row requires concurrent orders, a failed step, or migrated or external rows. Implementing TOP 1 needs the identity column name of the SIGMAVI table, which is NO EVIDENCE.

The code takes d.results[0].Werks (OM:1116-1119), then GetSucursalAsync(Werks) with $filter=Sucursal eq Werks (AccountMethods.cs:185-221). Centro = int.TryParse(Sucursal), or NULL (OM:1124-1155).

steps.step: 10. Atomicity between the burn and the regeneration
steps.lan: UPDATE and INSERT run in one SP execution, with only SQL between them (SP:118-159). An unknown agent only makes Sucursal NULL.
steps.sap: The UPDATE commits (OM:1093-1102). After it, a missing URL_BP_API throws (OM:1106-1107; it is set today, Web.config:30), and the agent HTTP call has no try (OM:1109-1122). A network error, a timeout (new HttpClient, default 100 s) or a non-JSON body reaches the outer catch (OM:1165-1169), and the INSERT never runs.
steps.note: This is a bug (see bugs). GetSucursalAsync, right after it, is wrapped in its own try (OM:1127-1139); the agent lookup is not.

steps.lan: @Codigo VARCHAR(30), @IdEcommerce VARCHAR(20), @Agente VARCHAR(10) (SP:52-54). The regenerated Codigo and Agente are cut to 10 characters (SP:133).
steps.sap: Full nvarchar values through AddWithValue (OM:1098-1099, 1154).
steps.note: The Magento credit checkout input has maxlength="10" (Mavi\CreditoCheckout\view\frontend\web\template\credito-checkout-template.html:82), and incrementId values such as CRED511270 are under 20 characters. The truncation has no practical effect.

steps.step: 12. Failure handling and whether a failure stops the order
steps.lan: CodigoPromocion catches SQL errors, logs 'ERROR <code>: <msg>' to codigoPromocion.log and returns 'err' (CreditMethods.cs:424-428). The caller logs the result to credit.log (:205) and continues: the Liberador still starts (:208-241) and SetPedido returns the cuenta (OrderMethods.cs:649). The input log call at :394 is outside the try; if it throws, the catch at :246 returns 'err' and the Liberador is skipped.

steps.note: On business behavior they are the same: a promo failure never stops the order on either side. The difference is diagnostics only: LAN leaves a file trace, SAP leaves none. See bug B2.

steps.step: 13. Outcome by case: invalid code / code already used / lookup service down
steps.lan: Invalid code: UPDATE matches 0 rows, and 'NUEVO' inserts a free row with Sucursal NULL (SP:118-159); the step returns '' (CreditMethods.cs:454-462). Already used (no free row): the same, and a new free row is inserted. DB down (MAVICUBOS): 'err' plus a file log. There are no external services.
steps.sap: Invalid code: 'NO_VALIDO', nothing written. Already used with no free row: SF and catalog are called; if valid, UPDATE matches 0 rows and a free row is inserted; if not, nothing. SF, AWS or android-api down: swallowed and treated as invalid, so nothing is written when there is no free row. When a free row exists, SF and AWS are never called. SIGMavi down or table missing: 'err', nothing written. businesspartner-api down: row burned, not regenerated. businesspartner-api non-2xx: Centro NULL and the insert still runs. SucursalesSet down: Centro NULL.
steps.note: The order still answers 'Concluido' in every case (OM:1804-1811).

steps.step: 14. Checkout validation that precedes the burn (context for the first use)
steps.lan: Magento requires 'OK' from ValidarCupon before placing a credit order with a promoter code (MAG Mavi\CreditoCheckout\...\credito-checkout-functions.js:236-241, 256-283). The Magento backend posts {codigo, opcion, idMagento} to the configured URL (Omnipro\MaviCredito\Model\CreditoManagement.php:589-602; the config value is NO EVIDENCE). The DMZ route credit/codigoPromocion forwards to URL_INTELISIS (DMZ Controllers\CreditController.cs:135; Helper\Curl.cs:22, 106). The LAN SP counts ANY row of the code (SP:64-70); for a valid employee with no row it inserts the first free row (SP:91-105), and 'Elimina' later stamps that row with the order.
steps.sap: order/validatecupon/{codigo} (Controllers\OrderController.cs:102-120) counts only FREE rows (OM:1041). It never inserts (OM:1085-1088) and returns JSON {status: OK|NO_VALIDO|err}, while Magento expects the plain strings OK/Erroneo/Utilizado (credito-checkout-functions.js:271-283). No DMZ route calls it, and ServicioSAP has no credit/codigoPromocion route.
steps.note: In the current topology, validation writes IntelisisTmp and the burn reads and writes SIGMavi. The first row of a promoter is created in one database and the burn looks in the other. See DEF-B.

steps.step: 15. Promoter recorded on the credit request row
steps.lan: SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS accepts @Agente (SP_CREDITO_WEB_DATOS.sql:151, inserted at :273/:334), but LAN does not pass it (CreditMethods.cs:150-188), so the value is NULL.
steps.sap: CrearSolicitudCreditoAsync does not set Agente (OM:803-840); SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:212/290 then writes NULL.
steps.note: On both sides the only link between the order and the promoter is the coupon row's IdEcommerce.

steps.step: 16. Latency added to the setOrder response
steps.lan: One SP call with CommandTimeout 120 s (CreditMethods.cs:414).
steps.sap: Up to 3 SQL connections (default 30 s) and up to 4 HTTP calls before 'Concluido': SF new HttpClient at 100 s (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:352); AWS shared client at 60 s (TokenGenerator.cs:98-103); BP API new HttpClient at 100 s (OM:1109); SucursalesSet via CreateClientS4 at 60 s (TokenGenerator.cs:126-127). SF and AWS run only when no free row exists.
steps.note: Low impact. Removing the gate under DEF-C would drop two of these calls. The DMZ timeout for order/new is NO EVIDENCE.

definitions_needed.question: W1 refined: which table and database is the single source of truth for promoter coupons? The candidates are SIGMAVI 'VentaCupon' (the confirmed name), SIGMAVI 'VentasCupones' (what the code uses), or IntelisisTmp.VTASCVentaCupon during the transition. Will the open IntelisisTmp rows be migrated before go-live?
definitions_needed.lan_behavior: Reads and writes IntelisisTmp.dbo.VTASCVentaCupon on MAVICUBOS, with columns IdVentaCupon, Codigo, Agente, FechaEnvio, Cliente, Sucursal, FechaUtilizacion, IdEcommerce. The branch comes from the Agente and Sucursal tables in the same database.
definitions_needed.sap_behavior: Reads and writes 'VentasCupones' in database SIGMavi through the server alias DEVMAVI, inserting the columns Codigo, Agente, FechaEnvio, BP, Centro. The host behind DEVMAVI is NO EVIDENCE. No DDL for VentasCupones or VentaCupon exists in the share.
definitions_needed.business_impact: Case 1: SIGMAVI only has 'VentaCupon'. The COUNT at OM:1041-1045 throws 'Invalid object name'. HandlePromoCodeAsync returns 'err' and nothing is burned or regenerated, for every promoter, with no log line; Magento still gets 'Concluido'. Case 2: the table exists but is empty at cutover. Every promoter goes through the SuccessFactors gate (DEF-C), and the coupons already issued in IntelisisTmp are never stamped. Case 3: SIGMAVI uses Cliente/Sucursal as column names. The INSERT fails after the UPDATE has already committed.
options: Rename to SIGMAVI 'VentaCupon' (per _DECISIONES_ODS.md:175) and map the INSERT columns to the real DDL
Keep 'VentasCupones', if SIGMAVI confirms it is the migrated copy of VTASCVentaCupon
Keep the burn in IntelisisTmp until validation and burn move to SIGMAVI together
definitions_needed.evidence: SP SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:1, 121, 146; LAN Conn\Connection.cs:26 (MAVICUBOS/IntelisisTmp); LAN CreditMethods.cs:401. SAP OM:1041, 1095, 1144-1145; Helpers\ConexionDB\ConexionSQL.cs:79; Web.config:160-161. _NUESTROS_ENDPOINTS\_DECISIONES_ODS.md:175 ('VTASCVentaCupon' -> 'VentaCupon', Confirmado); CHECKLIST_DEV3_NOSAP_NOINTELISIS.md:315-317 and :334; PLAN §18.8 (SIGMAVI row).
definitions_needed.recommendation: Ask SIGMAVI for: (1) the exact table name that exists (VentaCupon or VentasCupones) and in which server and database, including what 'DEVMAVI' resolves to; (2) its DDL: the identity/ordering column equivalent to IdVentaCupon (needed for TOP 1), the column names (Cliente/Sucursal or BP/Centro) and the widths of Codigo, Agente and IdEcommerce; (3) whether all VTASCVentaCupon rows, free and used, are migrated, and whether Intelisis keeps writing to the old table after cutover; (4) whether Centro/Sucursal uses the Intelisis branch numbering or the SAP Werks numbering. Then align the code to the answer. The confirmed naming convention points to 'VentaCupon'.

definitions_needed.question: Where does checkout validation (ValidarCupon) go after the migration? When it moves to ServicioSAP, must it behave like LAN: insert the promoter's first free row, accept any existing row (used or not), and answer 'OK'/'Erroneo'/'Utilizado'? Until then, should the burn stay in the same database that validation writes to?
definitions_needed.lan_behavior: Magento blocks a promoter-code credit order until ValidarCupon returns 'OK'. ValidarCupon counts any row of the code; for a valid employee with no row it inserts the first free row (SP:91-105). At setOrder, 'Elimina' stamps that row with FechaUtilizacion and IdEcommerce=incrementId (SP:118-128) and inserts the next free row.
definitions_needed.sap_behavior: Magento, through the DMZ, still validates against LAN, which writes IntelisisTmp. The burn runs in ServicioSAP against SIGMavi. ServicioSAP's own order/validatecupon counts only free rows, never inserts, and returns JSON {status: OK|NO_VALIDO|err}. Nothing calls it.
definitions_needed.business_impact: A promoter validates a code for the first time, and order CRED600001 follows. LAN ends with row R1 stamped IdEcommerce='CRED600001' plus a free R2, so the sale is attributed to the promoter. ServicioSAP today leaves R1 free forever in IntelisisTmp. In SIGMavi, if the gate passes, the UPDATE touches 0 rows and only a free R2 is inserted, so no row anywhere links CRED600001 to the promoter. If the gate fails, nothing is written at all.
options: Move validation to ServicioSAP at the same time as the burn, with LAN semantics (insert the first row, count any row, same response strings), plus a DMZ/Magento route for it
Keep validation in LAN and point the burn at the same store until both move
Accept that the first sale is not recorded (explicit business sign-off)
definitions_needed.evidence: MAG Mavi\CreditoCheckout\view\frontend\web\js\credito-checkout-functions.js:236-241, 256-283, 324; MAG Omnipro\MaviCredito\Model\CreditoManagement.php:589-602 (URL from config 'cupon_promotion', Helper\Data.php:41-42, value NO EVIDENCE); DMZ Controllers\CreditController.cs:127-138; DMZ Helper\Curl.cs:22, 93-106. SP SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:64-70, 91-105, 118-128. SAP Controllers\OrderController.cs:102-120; OM:1041, 1085-1088.
definitions_needed.recommendation: Move validation and burn together, and give ServicioSAP's ValidarCupon LAN's first-row insert and response vocabulary. Until then, any end-to-end promoter test needs the same code seeded in both IntelisisTmp and SIGMavi, or its result is meaningless. Ask Magento/Omnipro which URL 'mavi_credito/cupon_promotion' holds in each environment.

definitions_needed.question: Burn semantics at 'Elimina': keep LAN (no validation, stamp only the newest free row, always regenerate), or keep ServicioSAP's gate (free row, or SuccessFactors plus the AWS catalog) with its 'stamp all free rows' UPDATE?
definitions_needed.lan_behavior: No validation. UPDATE TOP (1) of the newest free row by IdVentaCupon DESC, then always insert a new free row for the code (SP:115-159).
definitions_needed.sap_behavior: Validates first (OM:1038-1083). Burns only if valid (OM:1091), stamps every free row (OM:1095) and regenerates only if valid (OM:1142-1158). A failure in SuccessFactors or the catalog counts as invalid and is not logged (OM:1079-1082).
definitions_needed.business_impact: Case 1, used-up or first-use code for an employee whose SF Department/Title does not match a catalog row (the manual says the catalog still holds legacy keys such as D40): LAN inserts a new free coupon; SAP writes nothing, so the promoter never gets a free coupon again. Case 2, android-api down: same as case 1. Case 3, a stale or unvalidated code, which Magento can send if the promoter box is unchecked after typing (credito-checkout-functions.js:236-248 sends promoCodeS at :324) or through the quote.bank fallback (OrderManagement.php:465-466, set by any validation at CreditoManagement.php:599): LAN creates a free coupon row for a non-promoter; SAP's gate prevents that. Case 4, two free rows: LAN stamps 1, SAP stamps both with the same IdEcommerce.
options: LAN parity: remove the gate from 'Elimina', UPDATE TOP (1) ... ORDER BY <identity> DESC, always insert (MATRIZ 4.1 #4 recommends this)
Keep the gate as a new business rule, but switch the UPDATE to TOP (1) and log gate rejections and failures

Keep the gate and define its rule precisely: catalog shape (single title or comma list like TablaStD), Department/Title names or DepartmentCode/TitleCode, and the meaning of status=0 compared with Estatus='Alta'
definitions_needed.evidence: SP SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:115-159 (and ValidarCupon rule :80-95 with fnSplit); SAP OM:1038-1091, 1095, 1142-1158; BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:350; Models\SAP\SuccessFactor\SuccessFactorEmployee.cs:64-77 (DepartmentCode/TitleCode exist but are not used); Models\Ecommerce\AlmacenesConfig.cs:65-87; MATRIZ_REGLAS_CREDITO_WEB_LAN_VS_SAP.md:205-206 (G5-07/G5-08), :245-249; Manual Tecnico Servicio SAP 26082026.md:292-293.
definitions_needed.recommendation: LAN parity: no gate at 'Elimina', TOP (1) newest free row, always regenerate. Validation already happens at checkout, which is where LAN put it. TOP (1) needs the identity column from the SIGMAVI DDL (DEF-A). If the business wants the gate, the catalog rule has to be defined first, or every promoter will be rejected.

definitions_needed.question: After the migration, which code does a promoter give (by SMS) and Magento send in codigo_promotor: the Intelisis personal/agent code (e.g. E016881) or the SAP/SuccessFactors personnel number (e.g. 30001558)?
definitions_needed.lan_behavior: The code is resolved natively against Intelisis ids: Personal=@Codigo (SP:80-84, validation only) and Agente=@Agente (SP:141-144, branch of the new coupon).
definitions_needed.sap_behavior: The raw code is sent as the SF user_id (BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:350) and as Zagente (OM:1108), which the API zero-pads to 10 characters (AS_ZQBP_AGENTE.py:95-96). Neither lookup is mapped from Intelisis ids.
definitions_needed.business_impact: The captured promoter order CRED511270 carries codigo_promotor 'E016881' (Manual Tecnico Peticiones Hoppscotch 01092026.md:879), while the SF and agent samples use numeric ids (30001558 at :2835; Zagente=30018095 in the collection's 'Get Agente'). With E-codes, the agent lookup queries '000E016881', so Centro is NULL. Whether SF finds an E-code is NO EVIDENCE; if it does not, a code with no free row fails the gate (DEF-C).
options: Magento/promoters switch to SAP personnel numbers, and existing coupon rows are re-keyed during migration
Keep Intelisis codes, and ServicioSAP maps them to SAP ids before the SF and ZQBP_AGENTE lookups (the source of the mapping must be defined)
definitions_needed.evidence: SP SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:80-84, 141-144; SAP OM:1059, 1108; BusinessPartnerMethods.cs:350; businesspartner-dev\apps\api\routes\AS_ZQBP_AGENTE.py:95-96; Hoppscotch manual :879, :2835.
definitions_needed.recommendation: Ask Magento and HR/SuccessFactors (with SIGMAVI, for the migrated coupon keys) which identifier promoters will use. Test data must use that format, and the Codigo values in the coupon table must match it.

bugs.summary: The coupon is burned but not regenerated when the agent lookup fails. The UPDATE commits at :1093-1102, but the AS_GET_ZQBP_AGENTE HTTP call (:1106-1122) has no try, so any network error, timeout or non-JSON body jumps to the outer catch (:1165-1169) and the INSERT (:1142-1158) never runs. LAN always inserts, with a NULL Sucursal if the agent is unknown (SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:139-159).
bugs.failure_scenario: businesspartner-api.mavi.fun times out (default 100 s) while order CRED511270 runs with a code that has one free row in the coupon table. The row is stamped used, no new free row is inserted, and HandlePromoCodeAsync returns 'err', which is discarded at :708 and never logged. The promoter now has 0 free rows. The next order with that code goes through the SuccessFactors gate and, if rejected, is never recorded again. Fix: wrap the agent lookup in try/catch as GetSucursalAsync already is (:1127-1139), and still INSERT with Centro NULL.

bugs.summary: Promo burn outcomes are invisible. The result ('err' or 'NO_VALIDO') is discarded at :708, and every failure inside HandlePromoCodeAsync goes only to Console.WriteLine (:1081, :1138, :1167), which is lost under IIS. Nothing reaches Logs/sap.log. LAN logged the input (CreditMethods.cs:394, codigoPromocion.log), errors (:426) and the result (:205, credit.log). This conflicts with R4 ('make every error visible with a log') and is below LAN's log level.
bugs.failure_scenario: SIGMAVI has 'VentaCupon' but not 'VentasCupones', or android-api is down. Every promoter order answers 'Concluido', no coupon is burned or regenerated, and neither sap.log nor any other file shows it happened. LAN would have written 'ERROR <code>: <message>' for each order. Fix: Logger.SAP the input and result at :708 (as LAN's :205), and Logger.SAP in the catches at :1081 and :1167 (as LAN's :426).

refuted_prior_claims.claim: PLAN §22.5 root cause #6 (PLAN_EJECUCION...md:1755): "Correction: 'first use leaves no IdEcommerce row' is not a difference — LAN's UPDATE TOP (1) also matches nothing on first use."
refuted_prior_claims.why: This is wrong for LAN's real flow. Magento will not place a credit order with a promoter code until ValidarCupon returns 'OK' (Mavi\CreditoCheckout\...\credito-checkout-functions.js:236-241, 256-283). For a valid employee with no row, LAN's ValidarCupon inserts the first free row (SpVTASVentaCupon.sql:91-105), so 'Elimina' finds and stamps it (SP:118-128). ServicioSAP's ValidarCupon never inserts (OM:1085-1088). In the current topology, validation writes IntelisisTmp (DMZ CreditController.cs:135 -> Curl.cs:106, URL_INTELISIS) while the burn reads SIGMavi. The first sale is recorded in LAN and not in ServicioSAP.

refuted_prior_claims.claim: promo-code-validation.json diff 5: 'At checkout Magento calls ValidarCupon (omnipro_pago_credito-method.js:784-800) and places the order only on "OK".'

Its template has no promo-code input (omnipro_pago_credito_form.html). Guest-credit orders do not get codigo_promotor at all (OrderManagement.php:461-468). The validation that gates credit client orders is in Mavi\CreditoCheckout\...\credito-checkout-functions.js:236-241 and 256-283.

areas.summary:
I checked the promoter-code handling in the credit flow against the current code on both sides. The ordering and the order's outcome match LAN, but the coupon table, the checkout validation behind the burn, and the burn rules themselves do not.

What matches LAN:
- **When it runs:** after the request row and the article lines, inside the same try, before the Liberador (LAN CreditMethods.cs:199-206; ServicioSAP OM:694-709).
- **A promo failure never stops the order:** LAN returns the cuenta (OrderMethods.cs:649); ServicioSAP returns 'Concluido' with the cuenta (OM:1804-1811).
- **Missing payment condition:** ServicioSAP skips the burn. This follows decision 9 ('se detiene').

What diverges:
- **Coupon table (W1):** LAN burns in IntelisisTmp.VTASCVentaCupon on MAVICUBOS. ServicioSAP uses 'VentasCupones' in SIGMavi through the server alias DEVMAVI. The SIGMAVI name recorded as confirmed is 'VentaCupon' (_DECISIONES_ODS.md:175), and there is no DDL for either name in the share.
- **Validation and burn are split:** Magento validates at checkout through the DMZ route credit/codigoPromocion, which still goes to LAN. On a promoter's first use, LAN's validation creates the first coupon row in IntelisisTmp; the burn now looks in SIGMavi. ServicioSAP's own order/validatecupon never inserts, counts only free rows, answers a different format, and nothing calls it. This refutes the "correction" in §22.5: in LAN the first sale is recorded on a coupon row, in ServicioSAP it is not.
- **Gate at burn time:** LAN's 'Elimina' has no validation. ServicioSAP burns only if a free row exists or SuccessFactors plus the AWS catalog accept the code; otherwise it writes nothing. An outage of either service counts as "invalid".
- **One row or all rows:** LAN stamps one row (UPDATE TOP(1), newest first). ServicioSAP stamps every free row of the code (OM:1095). This rarely matters: LAN's own flows keep at most one free row per code.
- **The 'NUEVO' row:** ServicioSAP inserts it, but only when the code passes the gate. It uses columns BP/Centro instead of Cliente/Sucursal, and takes the branch from the ZQBP_AGENTE Werks lookup plus SucursalesSet instead of Intelisis Agente.

Real bugs:
- **B1:** the coupon can be burned without being regenerated. The UPDATE commits before the agent HTTP call, and that call has no try (OM:1109).
- **B2:** promo results and errors never reach sap.log. The result is discarded at OM:708 and errors go only to Console.WriteLine; LAN wrote them to its log files.

Decisions for you, and what to ask SIGMAVI:
- **DEF-A (W1):** which table exists and on which server; its DDL (identity column, column names, widths); whether open coupon rows are migrated; which branch numbering Centro/Sucursal uses.
- **DEF-B:** move validation to ServicioSAP together with the burn, with LAN's behavior (insert the first row, same responses).
- **DEF-C:** LAN parity (no gate, one row, always regenerate), or keep the gate and define its catalog rule.
- **DEF-D:** which promoter code format Magento will send (E-code or SAP personnel number).

D1-D4 do not apply to this area.

bugs.summary: Validated phone numbers from SAP (ZtelCte) are used without digit normalization, but the SMS table stores digits only. The same number in '+52' form therefore compares as different, and IsValidatedAsync parses a wrong lada from it.
bugs.failure_scenario: Take a validated phone stored in SAP as '+523312345678', with the last SMS phone stored as '523312345678' (the SMS writer strips non-digits, SAP CreditMethods.cs:119). DistintoSql('+523312345678', '523312345678') returns true (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:318, :609), so ValidacionTelefono is 1; the SP compared digit-only Intelisis Lada+Telefono and would give 0. Its first two characters, '+5', are not a known 2-digit lada, so ladaValidar is '+52', which int.TryParse reads as 52. LadaValidar ends up 52 and TelefonoValidar '3312345678' instead of 33 and '12345678'. Captures show that '+52' and 7-digit ZtelCte values exist in to_CteTel (CAPTURAS_REALES_APIS.md:55, :61); for a MOVIL phone specifically there is NO EVIDENCE. The fix belongs with D2 option A (reduce ZtelCte to digits before comparing or parsing).

definitions_needed.sap_behavior: The header is written (OM:694). Then InsertCreditArticlesAsync throws (OM:877-880) before any line, SEGU00001 included. The catch at OM:711-717 only logs, and Magento gets Resultado 'Concluido' (OM:1806-1811). The promoter code is not burned. Keep writing the header, but rethrow from ProcessCreditPaymentAsync so Magento gets 'Error, ...'
Keep today's behavior (header, no lines, 'Concluido') and record it as intentional

Use only PaymentConditionCatalog for credit lines
Rewrite the query to LAN's semantics (WHERE Condicion=@magento, return the CondicionPropre equivalent), provided SIGMAVI holds the SD29 codes there

testability.payload_notes:
Endpoint: POST https://localhost:44399/order/new with header Authorization: Bearer <JWT from POST login/auth>. The body is an OrderRequest (Models/SAP/Order/OrderRequest.cs) and the controller calls SetOrderAsync(order, "Insert").

Fields that decide whether a request reaches the INSERT:
- metodoPago = "omnipro_pago_credito" (OrderMethods.cs:44, :1789).
- articulos: a non-empty list. ToArray iterates it without a null check (:222). Each item has sku, cantidad (int), condicion, precio, precioEspecial and descuento. condicion is the Magento text, e.g. "12 M MA P INM" or "12 M VIU P INM" as in the real payloads. It maps to 12IA/12IV through SigMavi CondicionesCredVtaLinea, or through PaymentConditionCatalog.cs:61/:64 as a fallback. A precioEspecial other than 0 turns forzarOrder to "1" internally, which only affects the SD36 check.
- incrementId: a new, unique value on every run, 20 chars or fewer (idMagento is varchar(20) per runbook §22.3). Credit is never deduplicated, because SD36 never finds a credit order.
- storeId: exactly "muebles_america" or "viu". This drives uen (:790), sucursal 504/505, SalesOrg 04/05 (:340-351) and the condition lookup (:3339).
- forzarOrder: "0" triggers the harmless SD36 read; "1" skips it.
- costoEnvio: a decimal; greater than 0 adds a SEGU00001 line.
- metodoEnvio: 12 chars or fewer until D1 is decided. The real value "tablerate_bestway" raises 8152.

infoCliente:
- cuenta: a numeric BP of SAP client 110, e.g. 1500008218 (R1). Never "C...", which is the negative case P10. With a BP, the header's names, birth date, RFC, sexo, cliente and entreCalles (when the payload sends none) come from BP05MA, not from the payload (SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:233-245, :274). BP Gender must be "1" or "2".
- cliente: the Magento customer id. Empty cuenta with a cliente is the new-client flow (R2); both empty is a guest and is rejected (:672-676).
- telefono: digits only, lada 2 digits for 33/55/81, else 3. It becomes Lada/TelefonoParticular and Celular, and is the fallback for LadaValidar/TelefonoValidar (:687-691, :795-801).
- Also used: correo, direccion, numExt, numInt, entreCalles, codigoPostal, municipio (goes to delegacion and poblacion), estado, colonia, nombreClienteMavi and the two apellido*ClienteMavi fields (guide name), and OrigenIdMagento.
- codigo_promotor: send "" (W1).

Order level, also used: utmSource, sucursalDestino (int), RedimirMonedero (float). entityId is only used by the commented callback.

Values that must be real SAP data: the BP in client 110 (it must exist in ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE and BP05MA) and a SKU with SD29 rows for OrgVtas 04/05 and a matching condition. Everything else can be synthetic.

The captured payloads CRED515773 (MA, costoEnvio 0) and CRED515848 (VIU, costoEnvio 150) are usable as templates only after replacing cuenta with a BP and metodoEnvio (or deciding D1), and giving them a new incrementId.

testability.summary:
Short answer: partly. The credit path can be tested, but not end-to-end yet, and only part of it right now.

**What a credit order does.** One credit order through SetOrderAsync, with a BP in cuenta:
- Optionally reads SD36 (only when forzarOrder is "0").
- Writes a local SQLite guide row.
- Reads ServicioAndroid for the last SMS phone, and reads BP05MA.
- Inside ProcessCreditPaymentAsync, reads ZB_DATOS_CLIENTE (existence check), BP05MA again, A_GET_TelefonoValidado, and when that returns a phone also CteTelSet, the AWS catalog and one more ServicioAndroid SELECT.
- Writes the header: INSERT CRED_SOLICITUD_WEB_DATOS_TEMP.
- Reads SigMavi CondicionesCredVtaLinea and SD29 per SKU, then writes the lines: INSERT VTASdArtCreditoWeb.
- Only if codigo_promotor is set, reads and writes SigMavi VentasCupones.

It makes no SAP write and calls no webhook. setCAccount is cash-only, and the liberador and callback are commented out.

**Harness.** None reaches this path. testnew posts a raw sales order straight to SAP and skips SetOrderAsync. There is no test project, no Postman or .http files, and the Fakes are not wired. The service runs under IIS Express on magalindo's machine (https://localhost:44399). sap.log shows local runs reaching SAP vhmvods4ci.sap.svrwes4h.com:44300, client 110, on 2026-07-17 (two cash orders; one created sales order 9846) and 2026-09-17 (a failed BP creation). It has nothing from the credit path and no GETs. bin/ServicioSap.dll was rebuilt in place at 2026-09-26 08:21:56 and now contains the new credit code.

**What can run now:**
- The build.
- Read-only GETs to A_GET_TelefonoValidado and the AWS catalog.
- SAP reads through the existing JWT-protected routes: partner/client, partner/client/ma, order/checkDocument, product/catalogo. The user has to start IIS Express and get the JWT.
- The SQL reads, which the user runs manually.

**What needs prerequisites.** Any order/new credit request, even a negative one, runs a SELECT on ServicioAndroid and writes the SQLite row. A positive run needs:
- a confirmed non-production database, which means editing Web.config connectionStrings;
- the user's go-ahead;
- a QA BP with Gender 1 or 2;
- D1 resolved. Both real payloads send metodoEnvio 'tablerate_bestway' and fail safely with 8152 at SolicitudCreditoWebMethods.cs:223. 'instore_pickup' would fail too.

D2 and D4 only change the expected ValidacionTelefono, D3 only a message, and W1 only matters when codigo_promotor is set.

**What is not possible.** End-to-end with Magento, because of R1 and R3.
